## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!music` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "playlist": [
    {
      "title": "Sunny Loop",
      "artist": "Zaileys Synth",
      "bpm": 96,
      "mood": "happy"
    },
    {
      "title": "Night Drive",
      "artist": "Zaileys Synth",
      "bpm": 84,
      "mood": "chill"
    },
    {
      "title": "Pixel Party",
      "artist": "Zaileys Synth",
      "bpm": 128,
      "mood": "chiptune"
    },
    {
      "title": "Cloud Nap",
      "artist": "Zaileys Synth",
      "bpm": 72,
      "mood": "dreamy"
    }
  ]
}

const card = html`

  var ICON = {

  var MOOD_COLORS = { happy: ["#ffc93c", "#ff8a3d", "#ff4f8b"], chill: ["#38b6ff", "#2ed8a7", "#7c5cff"], chiptune: ["#9be15d", "#ff4f8b", "#7c5cff"], dreamy: ["#b44cff", "#ff4f8b", "#38b6ff"] };
  var PAGE = 4;

  // Musical recipe per mood; unknown moods fall back to happy.

    dreamy: { minor: false, progs: [[0, 5, 3, 4], [0, 2, 3, 3], [3, 0, 4, 5]], keys: [62, 60, 64, 65], size: 4, lead: [69, 88], density: .3, longP: .6, swing: 0,
      kick: [0, 10], snare: [], hat: [2, 6, 10, 14], ghost: [], bass: [0, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, 0, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1, -1], bassLen: 14, fill: [] }
  };
  var MAJOR = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11], MINOR = [0, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10];

  function hash(s) { var h = 2166136261; for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { h ^= s.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619); } return h >>> 0; }
  function rng(seed) { var a = seed || 1; return function () { a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0; var t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a); t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t; return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; }; }
  function mtof(m) { return 440 * Math.pow(2, (m - 69) / 12); }
  function clamp(v, a, b) { return v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v; }
  function fmt(s) { if (!isFinite(s)) return "--:--"; s = Math.max(0, Math.floor(s)); return Math.floor(s / 60) + ":" + (s % 60 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (s % 60); }

  function buildSong(tr) {
    var st = STYLES[tr.style], r = rng(tr.seed), scale = st.minor ? MINOR : MAJOR;
    var key = st.keys[Math.floor(r() * st.keys.length)], prog = st.progs[Math.floor(r() * st.progs.length)];
    var stepDur = 60 / tr.bpm / 4, barDur = stepDur * 16;
    var bars = clamp(Math.round(45 / barDur / 4) * 4, 8, 32);
    var chords = prog.map(function (deg) { var out = []; for (var k = 0; k < st.size; k++) { var idx = deg + 2 * k; out.push(key + scale[idx % 7] + 12 * Math.floor(idx / 7)); } return out; });
    var pool = [];
    for (var m = st.lead[0]; m <= st.lead[1]; m++) if (scale.indexOf(((m - key) % 12 + 12) % 12) !== -1) pool.push(m);
    return { style: tr.style, st: st, key: key, stepDur: stepDur, bars: bars, steps: bars * 16, chords: chords, mel1: melody(r, st, pool, key, chords), mel2: melody(r, st, pool, key, chords) };
  }

  function nearest(pool, from, pcs) {
    var best = 0, bd = 99;
    for (var i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) { var pc = pool[i] % 12; if (pcs.indexOf(pc) === -1) continue; var d = Math.abs(i - from); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; } }
    return best;
  }

    for (var bar = 0; bar < 4; bar++) {
      var pcs = chords[bar].map(function (n) { return n % 12; });
      for (var pos = 0; pos < 16; pos += 2) {
        if (bar === 3 && pos >= 8) break;
        var strong = pos % 8 === 0;
        if (r() > (strong ? st.density + .3 : st.density)) continue;
        if (strong) idx = nearest(pool, idx + Math.floor(r() * 5) - 2, pcs);
        else idx = clamp(idx + [-2, -1, -1, 1, 1, 2][Math.floor(r() * 6)], 0, pool.length - 1);
        var len = r() < st.longP ? 4 : 2;
        mel[bar * 16 + pos] = { m: pool[idx], len: len };
        if (len === 4) pos += 2;
      }
    }
    mel[56] = { m: pool[nearest(pool, idx, [key % 12])], len: 8 };
    return mel;
  }

  function noiseBuf(c) {
    if (c.zNoise) return c.zNoise;
    var b = c.createBuffer(1, c.sampleRate, c.sampleRate), d = b.getChannelData(0);
    for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    c.zNoise = b;
    return b;
  }

  var stats = { voices: 0 };
  function tone(c, out, type, f, t, len, vol, o) {
    o = o || {};
    var osc = c.createOscillator(), g = c.createGain(), a = o.a || .006, rel = o.rel || .08, dest = out, end;
    len = Math.max(len, a + .01);
    end = t + len + rel + .05;
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t);
    if (o.drop) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(o.drop, t + (o.dropT || .1));
    if (o.detune) osc.detune.setValueAtTime(o.detune, t);

    g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + a);

      fl.type = "lowpass"; fl.Q.value = o.q || .7;

      if (o.cutTo) fl.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(o.cutTo, t + len + rel);
      fl.connect(out); dest = fl;

    if (o.vib) {

      lfo.frequency.value = 5.5; lg.gain.value = o.vib;

  }

  function snare(c, out, t, style, v) {

    $("now").style.visibility = open ? "hidden" : "";
    this.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open);
    if (open) { page = Math.floor(P.i / PAGE); renderList(); }
  });
  $("pgPrev").addEventListener("click", function () { page--; renderList(); });
  $("pgNext").addEventListener("click", function () { page++; renderList(); });

  var bar = $("bar");
  function fracAt(e) { var rc = bar.getBoundingClientRect(); return clamp((e.clientX - rc.left) / rc.width, 0, 1); }
  bar.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) { if (!isFinite(dur())) return; dragging = true; dragFrac = fracAt(e); try { bar.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (x) {} renderProgress(); });
  bar.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) { if (!dragging) return; dragFrac = fracAt(e); renderProgress(); });
  bar.addEventListener("pointerup", function (e) { if (!dragging) return; dragging = false; seekTo(fracAt(e) * dur()); });
  bar.addEventListener("pointercancel", function () { dragging = false; renderProgress(); });
  bar.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); seekTo(elapsed() + (e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 5 : -5)); }
  });

  setTrack(0);
  setStatus(TEXT.tap);
  render();
</script>
`

client.command('music', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Music player",
    height: 480,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The music player opens on WhatsApp Android only. Playlist: Sunny Loop, Night Drive, Pixel Party (example tracks generated by the card).",
    bypassDownload: false,
  })
})
```

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
